<think>**Preparing balanced CRC expressions**

**Factoring common q logic**

</think>

{
  "candidate_rtl": "module axis_eth_fcs_reset (
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst,
    input wire [7:0] s_axis_tdata,
    input wire s_axis_tkeep,
    input wire s_axis_tvalid,
    output wire s_axis_tready,
    input wire s_axis_tlast,
    input wire s_axis_tuser,
    output wire [31:0] output_fcs,
    output wire output_fcs_valid
);

    reg [31:0] crc_state;
    reg [31:0] fcs_reg;
    reg fcs_valid_reg;
    wire [31:0] crc_next;
    wire [7:0] q;

    // Factor each matching data/state pair before the parity network.
    assign q = s_axis_tdata ^ crc_state[7:0];

    // Constant-mask parity reductions implement the reference byte transform.
    assign crc_next[0]  = crc_state[8]  ^ (^(q & 8'h04));
    assign crc_next[1]  = crc_state[9]  ^ (^(q & 8'h09));
    assign crc_next[2]  = crc_state[10] ^ (^(q & 8'h13));
    assign crc_next[3]  = crc_state[11] ^ (^(q & 8'h26));
    assign crc_next[4]  = crc_state[12] ^ (^(q & 8'h4d));
    assign crc_next[5]  = crc_state[13] ^ (^(q & 8'h9a));
    assign crc_next[6]  = crc_state[14] ^ (^(q & 8'h30));
    assign crc_next[7]  = crc_state[15] ^ (^(q & 8'h61));
    assign crc_next[8]  = crc_state[16] ^ (^(q & 8'hc2));
    assign crc_next[9]  = crc_state[17] ^ (^(q & 8'h80));
    assign crc_next[10] = crc_state[18] ^ (^(q & 8'h04));
    assign crc_next[11] = crc_state[19] ^ (^(q & 8'h08));
    assign crc_next[12] = crc_state[20] ^ (^(q & 8'h11));
    assign crc_next[13] = crc_state[21] ^ (^(q & 8'h23));
    assign crc_next[14] = crc_state[22] ^ (^(q & 8'h46));
    assign crc_next[15] = crc_state[23] ^ (^(q & 8'h8c));
    assign crc_next[16] = crc_state[24] ^ (^(q & 8'h1d));
    assign crc_next[17] = crc_state[25] ^ (^(q & 8'h3b));
    assign crc_next[18] = crc_state[26] ^ (^(q & 8'h77));
    assign crc_next[19] = crc_state[27] ^ (^(q & 8'hee));
    assign crc_next[20] = crc_state[28] ^ (^(q & 8'hd8));
    assign crc_next[21] = crc_state[29] ^ (^(q & 8'hb4));
    assign crc_next[22] = crc_state[30] ^ (^(q & 8'h6c));
    assign crc_next[23] = crc_state[31] ^ (^(q & 8'hd8));
    assign crc_next[24] = ^(q & 8'hb5);
    assign crc_next[25] = ^(q & 8'h6f);
    assign crc_next[26] = ^(q & 8'hdf);
    assign crc_next[27] = ^(q & 8'hba);
    assign crc_next[28] = ^(q & 8'h71);
    assign crc_next[29] = ^(q & 8'he3);
    assign crc_next[30] = ^(q & 8'hc3);
    assign crc_next[31] = ^(q & 8'h82);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst)
            crc_state <= 32'hffffffff;
        else if (s_axis_tvalid)
            crc_state <= s_axis_tlast ? 32'hffffffff : crc_next;
    end

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst)
            fcs_reg <= 32'h00000000;
        else if (s_axis_tvalid && s_axis_tlast)
            fcs_reg <= ~crc_next;
    end

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (rst || !s_axis_tvalid)
            fcs_valid_reg <= 1'b0;
        else
            fcs_valid_reg <= s_axis_tlast;
    end

    assign s_axis_tready = 1'b1;
    assign output_fcs = fcs_reg;
    assign output_fcs_valid = fcs_valid_reg;
endmodule
",
  "bottleneck": "The reference CRC transform contains long XOR chains that mix low CRC-state bits, upper CRC-state bits and input data before reaching the CRC-state and FCS register input selection logic.",
  "rewrite": "Factor s_axis_tdata XOR crc_state[7:0] into eight shared signals, then express the exact reference transform as constant-mask parity reductions. This exposes shallower parity trees and keeps upper-state bits outside the low-byte parity network. Preserve crc_state, fcs_reg and fcs_valid_reg names and encodings, together with their original update conditions.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected improvement comes from reducing the deepest CRC XOR cone to one input-pair XOR stage, a small parity tree and, where required, one upper-state XOR. No additional register latency is introduced. Actual WNS improvement requires synthesis and STA with the specified mapping and constraints; no measured timing result is claimed.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Retains the original 65 register bits and adds no pipeline stages or helper modules. Factoring should reduce redundant XOR work, although shared low-byte signals may require buffering. Compliance with the 5033.202240 um2 area cap and electrical limits requires mapped evaluation.",
  "functional_boundaries": "All resets remain synchronous and take priority. A valid last byte captures the complement of the updated CRC and resets crc_state to all ones on the same edge. Invalid cycles hold CRC and FCS state and clear output validity. FCS data holds whenever no valid last byte is accepted, except during reset. Ready remains constantly asserted; keep and user remain ignored. The combinational transform is algebraically identical for every defined CRC state and input byte, with no initialization or startup assumptions added."
}
